Fanorona

The national game of Madagascar: capture by approach and withdrawal. Move pieces along lines on a 9×5 grid. Capture by moving toward an enemy line (approach) or away from one (withdrawal), taking all pieces in the unbroken line.

1 Variants
draughts Plugin
✓ Frontmatter-only

Declared, Not Coded

Every rule of Fanorona below is frontmatter in the rules corpus, played by the draughts plugin. The board beside each is the game itself, live.

Fanorona (Standard) Rules

Move pieces along lines on a 9×5 grid. Capture by moving toward an enemy line (approach) or away from one (withdrawal), taking all pieces in the unbroken line.

engine:
  topology:
    type: grid
    rows: 5
    cols: 9
    layout: intersections
  players: [white, black]
  plugin: draughts
  plugins:
    fanorona:
      directions: all
      manMove: all
      manCapture: all
      promotion: false
      forcedCapture: true
      piecesPerPlayer: 22
      captureMethods: [approach, withdrawal]
      chain:
        optional: true
        revisit: false
        repeatDirection: false
